message: I am exploring a small UAE consultancy for cloud automation.
I want to understand whether company formation is the right path for my new software practice.
The activity will be cloud architecture and software advisory.
I am considering an LLC, with two visas initially and a target of next quarter.
Please keep the business activity as cloud architecture, not general trading.
My expected visa requirement is two people at launch.
The target timeline is next quarter; I am not asking you to register anything yet.
Correction: use LLC as the structure rather than a sole establishment.
I previously said three visas; please retain two instead.
The activity is cloud architecture and software advisory, and that correction should not change the timeline.
Do you still have my requested structure and visa count in this conversation?
Keep this company-formation goal active while I ask a general question.
What requirement is currently still missing from my request?
Please ask only one useful follow-up question for the current step.
Can you explain the formation process at a high level without inventing legal rules?
What should I verify before relying on an eligibility answer?
Can you answer a general process question using approved information only?
If approved information is unavailable, please say what you cannot verify.
What is the next verified action for this opportunity?
Has any account action actually completed, or is it still pending?
Please distinguish a proposed action from a provider-confirmed action.
Do not claim that a document was attached externally unless there is a verified receipt.
What approved package information can you show me before I select anything?
I want to compare the available package facts without changing my journey.
What information should I review before confirming a quotation?
Please do not invent a discount or price that is not in the approved catalog.
Which document requirement is currently associated with my selected package?
What happens after a supported document is uploaded for review?
Please tell me whether local processing and external attachment are separate statuses.
I can provide a harmless synthetic PDF once the package is confirmed.
I am retrying a status question; please preserve the same session context.
If a provider times out, explain that it is pending rather than claiming success.
I changed my mind about the visa count; acknowledge the correction only if it is persisted.
Please continue after a knowledge interruption without restarting the journey.
